extra_context: We're a small fine jewelry boutique where I design and hand-fabricate every piece at my bench — engagement rings, heirloom-style necklaces, that kind of thing. Most of my clients are people marking a big moment and they want something that feels personal, not mass-produced. I want the website to feel calm and unhurried, like stepping into a quiet spa — soft, warm, a little hushed and luxurious. The one thing that sets us apart: every commission comes with a hand-sketched design on cotton paper before we ever touch metal, and clients keep the original sketch.
